pod-top.what: cockpit pod from above: long red armour body, rounded nose to the right, the canopy area and the dorsal strip channel stay red plate

nacelle-top.what: gun nacelle from above: long red armour body, tapered gun end to the right

aft-top.what: aft body from above: the broad red armour block joining both pods and the wing roots

wing-top-port.what: port wing plate from above: a swept red armour plate, leading edge to the right

wing-top-stbd.what: starboard wing plate from above (mirror of the port wing)

stern-top.what: stern steel from above: the two drive drums and the centre spine between them, grey worn steel

side-stbd.what: starboard flank: the cockpit pod and aft body side walls and the wing edge, red armour

side-port.what: port flank: the gun nacelle and aft body side walls and the wing edge, red armour

underside.what: the whole belly from below: pod, nacelle, aft body and both wings, red armour
